title: Prove sharp bounded-reserve contraction for two types (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped written proof with exact finite corroboration, produced by Nick Petalas. For arbitrary finite two-type nonnegative row menus, determine the sharp common contraction rate when positive reserve weights have imbalance at most B >= 1.

```text
q_B = max {
  max_(a,b) (a+b/B),
  max_(c,d) (d+c/B),
  max_row_pairs (a+d+sqrt((a-d)^2+4bc))/2
}.
```

The proof supplies the entire feasible weight interval at every rate and shows that rational weights attain the optimum exactly when the optimum is rational, for rational rows and B. A new four-row example has exact law max(1/(2B),sqrt(2)/4). The reserve cap also gives the all-depth abstract relative tail bound B*q^k.

Ali Romman's [#6472](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6472) supplies the independent adaptive-row contract and explicit common-ratio question. Its existing result is cited, not replayed. Older [#6555](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6555) solves one uncapped fixture; its menu, identity and cutoff are not used as the main step. Classical Perron roots, positive diagonal scaling and weighted contraction retain their credit; global priority for those methods is unclaimed.

[Advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19542404). Canonical base e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57; selected frontier unchanged.

## Evidence

Before, the cited adaptive-row interface supplied valid common weights without an explicit arbitrary-menu reserve-cap optimum. After, the closed form and complete interval give an exact rational feasibility certificate.

- All 30,375 rational decisions agree with a separate normalized-polytope vertex enumeration that tests the original row inequalities and uses no row-pair determinant: 11,831 feasible and 18,544 infeasible.
- The verifier checks every delivered interval endpoint and midpoint, 455 exact transition thresholds, 387 tail prefixes and 14 rejecting controls. The universal claim rests on PROOF.md, not finite extrapolation.
- Warning-strict normal and optimized CPython 3.12.15 replays have identical generated hash-bound receipts. Registered metadata/pins and committed-byte/source-history checks pass. Each registered command was timed locally: 0.82 s normal and 0.84 s optimized, under its 120-second bound.

From the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/bounded-adaptive-reserves/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/bounded-adaptive-reserves/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/bounded-adaptive-reserves
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/bounded-adaptive-reserves --check-source-history
```

Another CPython 3.12 executable can replace the host-specific path. Expected markers are PASS_BOUNDED_ADAPTIVE_RESERVES, PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE and PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES. No predecessor executable, receipt or scientific census is imported.

## Limitations

No actual physical supplier menu or reserve consumer is bound. Native realization, complete charges, independent row legality, compiler closure, ownership, stock, precision/tape and analytic recovery remain separate. All five selected framework assumptions remain; there is no new kappa or complete multiplication theorem. Selected cold replay, Lean, Docker, independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

The theorem covers arbitrary finite nonnegative real menus. The executable checks rational thresholds with at most sixteen rows per type and 64-bit input numerators/denominators. Its managed-allocation deviation and fixed replay bounds are documented. No shared source or pinned evidence changes.

## Open next questions

1. Bind one complete current two-type menu and a real reserve consumer, including every child, adapter and restoration charge and the permissible B.
2. Find a useful higher-type certificate that retains all pairwise reserve constraints; the two-type interval formula does not supply that extension.

## Related open work

- [#7151](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7151) bounds retained backend backing with a finite-stage Bellman certificate. This result instead optimizes positive scaling under an explicit cap for abstract two-type row menus; it does not compute or reassess that physical reserve.

The completion check of this account's open PRs created after the advance CLAIM found no additional PR studying this two-type contraction or reserve-cap quantity.

Main, live PRs and claims were refreshed before committing. Distinctive reserve-cap, general-menu and formula searches found no prior delivery of this result. Sparse omitted notes, arbitrary historical diffs and unpublished work remain coverage limits.

## CI notes

CI did not certify this package. At unchanged head `18cd386d47b415fcc6c6cddde9ae1ac3d1c8749e`, [run 43029125610](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43029125610), [plan job 130551298799](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43029125610/job/130551298799), failed in `Onboarding helper tests`. The log reports exactly one failure among 760 tests, with 24 skipped:

```text
test_research_current_status.CurrentCiNavigationTests.test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record
AssertionError: '`make frontier7000-verify`' not found
FAILED (failures=1, skipped=24)
```

This failure is inherited from canonical base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`: `certificates/selected-result.json` specifies `make frontier7000-verify`, while the current section of `docs/ci-verification.md` still describes #6030 and `make frontier6030-verify`. Both base files were read directly; this PR changes only its six package files. The `replay` job was skipped because `plan` failed, so no hosted scientific replay ran.

The failed-job logs for [42905094314](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/42905094314), [42903313790](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/42903313790), [43023514635](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43023514635), [43024693032](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43024693032) and [43029249083](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43029249083) were read and each confirms the same exact failing test, missing-command assertion and one-failure/24-skipped summary across 760 tests. No unrelated CI failure is inferred.

Local normal/optimized direct checks, both registered commands, metadata/pins and committed-byte/source-history checks passed as recorded above. Those are local evidence only. The repository navigation repair remains for maintainers; no fix or retrigger commit is added here.

## Merge Danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: one isolated research package and two bounded replay commands. No shared implementation or selected-frontier files change.
